bundle.shortDescription: Generate app icons for every platform from a single image
bundle.longDescription: Tauricon turns one image (PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG) into complete, store-ready icon sets for iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, macOS, Android, Windows, the Web and Tauri apps. It includes a style editor, Android adaptive and themed icon layers, batch processing and Xcode/Android image sets. Everything runs locally; your images never leave your computer.
